0=无调制、1=单路数字（无副载波）、2=单路数字（有副载波）、3=单路模拟、7: 0 = no modulation, 1 = single-channel digital (no sub-carrier), 2 = single-channel digital (with sub-carrier), 3 = single-channel analogue, 7/8 = multi-channel digital/analogue, 9 = composite
3 位数字 + 1 位单位字母（H=Hz、k=kHz、M=MHz、G=GHz），: Three digits plus one unit letter (H = Hz, k = kHz, M = MHz, G = GHz); the decimal point is replaced by the unit letter
30MHz 以下 ≤ 1000W；30MHz 以上 ≤ 25W: ≤ 1000 W below 30 MHz; ≤ 25 W above 30 MHz
30MHz 以下 ≤ 15W（不大于 15W）；30MHz 以上 ≤ 25W: ≤ 15 W below 30 MHz (not more than 15 W); ≤ 25 W above 30 MHz
A=人工电报、B=自动电报、C=传真、D=数据/遥测、E=电话、F=电视、W=组: A = manual telegraphy, B = automatic telegraphy, C = facsimile, D = data/telemetry, E = telephony, F = television, W = combination, X = other
A=双边带、J=单边带抑制载波、R=单边带减幅载波、F=调频、G=调相、D=幅角: A = double sideband, J = single sideband suppressed carrier, R = single sideband reduced carrier, F = frequency modulation, G = phase modulation, D = amplitude/angle combination, K/L/M/P = pulse
ARRL Antenna Book、NEC 建模: ARRL Antenna Book and NEC modelling
B 类 30MHz 以下不大于 15W: Class B: not more than 15 W below 30 MHz
CQ CQ CQ，这里是 BG4XXX 普遍呼叫，并守听。: CQ CQ CQ, this is BG4XXX calling CQ and standing by.
J3E 的 3 表示单路模拟信号: The 3 of J3E indicates a single-channel analogue signal
J3E 的 E 表示电话: The E of J3E indicates telephony
J3E 的首位 J 表示单边带抑制载波: The leading J of J3E indicates single sideband with suppressed carrier
J3EJN 表示带前向纠错的单边带数据: J3EJN denotes single-sideband data with forward error correction
VHF/UHF 手台与中继台最常用（FM 话）: Most common on VHF/UHF handhelds and repeaters (FM phone)
WSJT-X（FT8 / FT4 / JS8 / Q65）、WSPR、AX.25: WSJT-X (FT8 / FT4 / JS8 / Q65), WSPR and the AX.25 / APRS specifications
《业余无线电台管理办法》（工信部令第 67 号，2024-03-01 施行）: Measures for the Administration of Amateur Radio Stations (MIIT Decree No. 67, in force 2024-03-01)
《中华人民共和国无线电频率划分规定》（2023-07-01 施行）: Radio Frequency Allocation Regulations of the People's Republic of China (in force 2023-07-01)
以主管部门最新公告为准: The latest announcements of the competent authority prevail
以各项目最新文档为准: The latest documentation of each project prevails
保留部分载波的单边带电话: Single-sideband telephony retaining part of the carrier
入门类别，覆盖 VHF/UHF 及微波频段，适合手台、车台和中继通联。: The entry class, covering the VHF/UHF and microwave bands; suited to handhelds, mobiles and repeater operation.
双边带调幅传真（静止图像），第三符号 C = 传真。: Double-sideband AM facsimile (still images); the third symbol C = facsimile.
发射类别完整表至少 15 项: The complete emission class table has at least 15 entries
可进行短波（HF）通联，但功率受限。: HF contacts are possible, but with limited power.
含 ITU《无线电规则》编号脚注（如 5.282）: Includes numbered footnotes of the ITU Radio Regulations (e.g. 5.282)
增益 / 前后比为典型量级: Gain and front-to-back ratio are typical orders of magnitude
如测向信标发射的音频摩尔斯标识: Such as the aural Morse identification transmitted by direction-finding beacons
带全载波的单边带，便于普通 AM 接收机解调。: Single sideband with full carrier, so that ordinary AM receivers can demodulate it.
抑制载波单边带，用于 PSK31 等数据: Suppressed-carrier single sideband, used for data such as PSK31
抑制载波的单边带调幅话音（SSB 话）: Single-sideband AM telephony with suppressed carrier (SSB phone)
接近纯音，略有交流纹波: Near pure note with slight ripple
接近纯音，略有调制痕迹: Near pure note with traces of modulation
描述复用、前向纠错、加密等附加信息: Describes additional information such as multiplexing, forward error correction and encryption
最高类别，短波段可使用大功率。: The highest class; high power may be used on the HF bands.
残留边带调幅，模拟电视广播的标准方式（VSB）。: Vestigial-sideband AM, the standard method for analogue television broadcasting (VSB).
用单边带方式传送的传真图像: Facsimile images transmitted by single sideband
用调频方式传送图像（SSTV / 业余电视）: Images transmitted by FM (SSTV / amateur television)
由机器自动接收，如 RTTY: Received automatically by machine, e.g. RTTY
由机器（译码器 / 计算机）自动接收的莫尔斯电报: Morse telegraphy received automatically by machine (decoder / computer)
直接 FSK 传数据，如 9600 波特分组无线电: Direct FSK data, e.g. 9600 baud packet radio
相位调制的单信道数字数据（PSK 类数据模式），第三符号 D = 数据。: Single-channel digital data with phase modulation (PSK-type data modes); the third symbol D = data.
第 1 位 · 主载波调制: 1st character · modulation of the main carrier
第 2 位 · 调制信号性质: 2nd character · nature of the modulating signal
许多所谓调频电台实际采用的相位调制: The phase modulation actually used by many radios called FM
询问频率是否占用: Ask whether the frequency is in use
这里是 BG4XXX，请讲。: This is BG4XXX, please go ahead.
音频副载波调频传数据，如 1200 波特分组无线电: Data carried on an FM audio sub-carrier, e.g. 1200 baud packet radio
